summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by Ribbon Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, disclosing that an extension payment of $125,000 was deposited into its trust account on August 11, 2026, to extend its deadline to consummate an initial business combination by one month, from August 15, 2026 to September 15, 2026. This is a standard SPAC extension notice, not a special-situation event itself. No M&A, tender, activist, or restructuring terms are present. The extension provides time for deal completion; watch for subsequent announcements regarding a target business combination before the new deadline.
